facts.claim: There were 83 municipalities in 1881, excluding the Civil and Military Station of Bangalore.
facts.quote: Excluding that of the Civil and .Military Station of Bangalore, which remained under British Administration, there were 83 Municipalities in 1881.

facts.claim: By the year 1895, the number of municipalities had increased to 112.
facts.quote: By 1895 the number had risen to 112.
